title: Executive Assistant
description:
London (Hybrid Working) Permanent

The Bukola Group is delighted to be partnering with a highly respected national organisation to recruit an experienced Executive Assistant to support a number of senior office holders in a fast-paced and complex environment.

This is a highly visible, public-facing role. The successful candidate will provide dedicated support to some of the organisation's most senior representatives, who regularly engage with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders and act as key public ambassadors for the organisation.

The Role

You will be responsible for providing proactive and professional executive support, including:
- Managing complex and ever-changing diaries
- Coordinating meetings, events and travel arrangements
- Acting as a key point of contact on behalf of senior leaders
- Preparing correspondence, briefings and meeting documentation
- Building strong relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders
- Supporting governance and leadership activities within a complex organisational structure
- Handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism

About You

We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant or Senior PA with:
- Proven experience supporting senior executives or leadership teams
- Outstanding organisational and prioritisation skills
- Experience managing multiple competing demands and deadlines
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
- Strong judgement, discretion and attention to detail
- Advanced Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 skills
- Experience working within a charity, membership, public sector or similarly complex organisation would be advantageous.

What's on Offer
- Hybrid working, however office presence will be required initially as part of the training process
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Pension scheme
- Opportunity to work at the heart of a high-profile leadership function within a respected national organisation.

For a confidential discussion or to express your interest, please contact The Bukola Group.

title: Temporary Complaints Handler Immediate Start
description:
Are you a skilled communicator with a knack for problem-solving? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your empathy and investigative mindset can shine? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our client as a Temporary Complaints Handler!

Job Title: Temporary Complaints Handler - 3 months

Location: Covent Garden

Start Date: ASAP
Duration: 3 months

Pay: 19.23

Hours: 09:00 - 18:00 - fully office based

Role Purpose
As a Complaints Handler, you will be the voice of reason for customers, guiding them through their concerns from initial receipt to resolution. Your role is crucial in ensuring that each case is handled professionally, fairly, and in compliance with company policy and regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage a diverse portfolio of customer complaints, ensuring timely resolution.
- Conduct thorough investigations by reviewing evidence and collaborating with internal teams.
- Assess complaints objectively to deliver fair and balanced outcomes.
- Draught clear, professional written responses and engage in sensitive phone conversations.
- Identify resolutions that balance customer expectations with organisational needs.
- Maintain detailed case notes and ensure compliance with GDPR and company policies.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Proven experience in handling customer complaints or escalated service cases.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong investigative and analytical abilities with a focus on problem-solving.
- Ability to manage difficult conversations while making sound decisions.
- Highly organised with the capacity to juggle multiple cases independently and collaboratively.
- Proficiency in CRM/case management systems and MS Office applications.

Desirable Experience:
- Previous experience in a regulated industry.
- Familiarity with complex complaint investigations and dispute resolution processes.

Personal Attributes
We're looking for a calm, composed individual who is:
- Empathetic yet objective, demonstrating resilience and adaptability.
- Naturally curious with an investigative mindset and a fair, impartial approach.
- A strong collaborator who takes ownership of their work and maintains professionalism under pressure.

Key Competencies:
- Complaint investigation
- Dispute & conflict resolution
- Customer service excellence
- Critical thinking & problem solving
- Decision making
- Time management & prioritisation
- Attention to detail

Performance Measures:
Your success will be measured by SLA achievement, the quality and accuracy of investigations, documentation accuracy, and compliance with procedures and regulations.

Why Join Us?
This is an excellent opportunity to enhance your skills in a supportive environment while making a real difference for customers. If you're ready to take on this rewarding challenge and help resolve customer concerns with finesse, we'd love to hear from you!

Application Process:
To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience to (url removed)

Embark on a fulfilling journey with our client, where your contributions will truly matter. Apply now and become an integral part of a team dedicated to customer satisfaction!

Note: This is a temporary position with the potential for growth and further opportunities within the organisation. Don't miss out on this chance to showcase your talents!

title: Operations & Sales Coordinator
company: Streamline Services Consultancy Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Streamline Recruitment have a fantastic opportunity for an Operations & Sales Coordinator to join our client's well-established business based in East London.

Our client is one of the world's leading manufacturers and suppliers of wood veneer, veneer edging and veneered boards. For over 60 years, they have built an outstanding reputation across the industry.

Due to continued success, they are looking for an Operations & Sales Coordinator to join their close-knit team. This is a varied role where no two days are the same, offering the opportunity to work closely with customers, suppliers and logistics partners while playing an important role in ensuring orders are managed smoothly from enquiry through to delivery.

The Role

As the first point of contact for many customers, you will be responsible for managing customer orders, coordinating deliveries and supporting the wider sales and operations function. You will ensure all enquiries, quotations and orders are handled accurately, efficiently and with a strong focus on customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing customer orders and managing them through to successful completion.
- Checking stock availability and liaising with internal teams.
- Reviewing customer enquiries and quotations, following up where appropriate.
- Coordinating deliveries with third-party logistics providers.
- Monitoring customer deliveries and resolving any issues quickly and professionally.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
- Identifying opportunities to upsell products and support additional sales.
- Providing excellent customer service via telephone and email.
- Supporting the wider sales and operations team with day-to-day administration.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- A confident communicator with strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Experienced in customer service, sales support, order processing or a similar office-based role.
- Comfortable liaising with customers, suppliers and internal teams.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and CRM/ERP systems.
- Reliable, positive and willing to be part of a friendly, supportive team.

What's on Offer?
- Monday to Friday working hours 7:30am to 4:30pm
- £32-40k DOE
- 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays (5 days reserved for the Christmas shutdown)
- The opportunity to join a successful family-run business with over 60 years of industry experience.
- Flexible and approachable management who value their employees.
- Long-term career stability and development opportunities.
- A varied role where you can genuinely make a difference every day.

If you're looking for a company where people genuinely enjoy coming to work, where teamwork is valued and your contribution is recognised, this could be the perfect opportunity.

You'll be joining a hardworking yet easy-going team who support one another and take pride in delivering exceptional service to their customers.

title: Estate Coordinator
description:
Estate Coordinator - Permanent, Canary Wharf (E14)

Hours: 40 per week, 08:30 - 17:30 Monday to Friday

Salary: 34,000 to 37,000 per annum dependant on skills & experience

Ballymore is an independently owned property developer with a reputation for delivering some of the UK's most distinctive residential and mixed-use developments. Our communities are carefully designed to create exceptional places to live, work and thrive. Wardian is one of London's most iconic residential developments, known for its luxury living experience, stunning architecture, and world-class resident services.

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Estate Coordinator to join our team at Wardian. This is an excellent opportunity for an administrative professional with strong organisational skills and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service within a residential property management environment.

The Role

As Estate Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the Estate Management team and ensuring the smooth delivery of property management services across the development. You will act as a central point of coordination, overseeing administrative processes, supporting compliance activities, assisting with resident communications, and helping drive operational excellence across the estate.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and committed to delivering a first-class service to residents, leaseholders, clients, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilties

Administration & Coordination
- Manage written correspondence, emails, and documentation relating to property management activities.

title: HR Operations Administrator
description:
Are you the person who gets satisfaction from clearing the inbox, solving the query, completing the paperwork and knowing everything has actually been finished?

We are looking for a bright, organised and resourceful HR Operations Administrator to join a busy HR team.

This role is all about keeping things moving.

A significant part of your day will involve managing the HR mailbox, responding to straightforward employee queries, finding information, signposting people to the right place and making sure requests do not disappear into the system.

What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing and responding to queries through the HR mailbox
- Providing first-line HR information to employees
- Signposting more complex queries to the appropriate colleague
- Preparing routine HR documentation
- Supporting starters, leavers and contractual changes
- Maintaining accurate employee records
- Supporting absence and probation processes
- Liaising with payroll and HR colleagues
- Tracking actions and deadlines
- Updating HR systems
- Researching answers when information is not immediately available
- Making sure queries and tasks are followed through to completion

The organisation uses Unit 4 ERPx, so experience of Unit 4 would be a real bonus, although it is certainly not essential.

The person we are looking for

You do not need to know everything.

What matters is what you do when you do not know the answer.

Do you sit and wait for someone to tell you, or do you look at the policy, check the system, find the right person, ask the question and get the issue resolved?

We want the latter.

You will need:
- Previous HR administration or HR operations experience
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- Confidence dealing with employees and colleagues
- Strong written communication skills
- Good general HR knowledge
- The ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
- Confidence using and learning HR systems
- Initiative and common sense
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload
- A strong sense of personal responsibility for deadlines

Most importantly, you will be someone who finishes things.

If you say you will get something done, you get it done. If there is a problem, you raise it. If you do not know something, you find out.

Who could this suit?

Perhaps you are an experienced HR Administrator or HR Coordinator who genuinely enjoys operational HR and is not chasing the next management title.

Alternatively, you may be earlier in your HR career but exceptionally capable, quick to learn and confident working independently.

Either could work.

What matters most is that you are proactive, reliable, responsive and comfortable working in a busy environment where you will need to use your own initiative.

Gray & Associates is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

title: Continuity of Care Coordinator
description:
Continuity of Care Coordinator

Location: Based primarily at HMP Brixton

Salary: £18,049.02 per annum

Vacancy Type: Permanent

About The Role

Are you passionate about improving outcomes for people leaving prison and making sure they receive the right support when they return to the community?

We're looking for an enthusiastic and organised Continuity of Care Coordinator to join our substance misuse team at HMP Brixton. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in strengthening the journey from prison into community treatment, building effective partnerships and helping ensure people leaving custody experience a safe and supported transition.

Based primarily at HMP Brixton, you'll work across our London services, including HMP Wormwood Scrubs and Heathrow IRC, so some travel will be required. Reasonable travel expenses will be covered.

What you will be doing

You'll be at the heart of improving continuity of care across our London prison services. Your responsibilities will include:
- Leading monthly release audits, ensuring service users are correctly discharged on NDTMS and that any data issues are identified and resolved.
- Completing pre-release audits to make sure community teams are fully informed and prepared for an individual's release.
- Ensuring alert forms and key information are shared with community services so that support can continue without unnecessary delays.
- Building strong relationships with local authority and community substance misuse teams, developing effective referral pathways and joint-working arrangements.
- Keeping up to date with local community treatment offers and ensuring prison teams have the information they need to support successful referrals.
- Establishing and chairing continuity of care forums, bringing partners together to identify challenges, share learning and improve outcomes.
- Producing accurate meeting minutes, actions and progress updates, ensuring agreed improvements are followed through.
- Acting as a key point of contact for community prison in-reach workers, helping them overcome barriers and supporting effective pre-release reviews.
- Leading regional NDTMS and other relevant audits, identifying opportunities to improve data quality and performance.
- Supporting the organisation of release fairs and events within the prison, helping service users connect with community support.
- Regularly reviewing and updating the Continuity of Care Best Practice Framework, ensuring it reflects current guidance and good practice.
- Developing strong community partnerships that improve continuity of care and outcomes for service users.
- Working collaboratively with Health and Justice colleagues, NHSE and OHID to support the delivery of commissioning projects and initiatives.
- Sharing best practice, progress and learning with managers and teams across the region.

What we are looking for

We're looking for someone who is passionate about partnership working and committed to making a real difference to people moving from prison back into the community.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience of working within substance misuse, health, criminal justice or a related setting.
- A strong understanding of the challenges people can face when transitioning from prison into community services.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work confidently with a wide range of partners.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage audits, meetings, actions and deadlines effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with data, records and performance information.
- The confidence to chair meetings, influence others and drive actions forward.
- Experience of working collaboratively across different organisations and professional teams.
- The ability to identify barriers, find practical solutions and continuously look for ways to improve services.
- A proactive and motivated approach, with the confidence to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- A commitment to person-centred support, equality and improving outcomes for people affected by substance misuse and the criminal justice system.
- The flexibility to travel between London sites when required.

This is more than an administrative coordination role. You'll have the opportunity to shape how continuity of care is delivered across London, strengthen relationships between prison and community services, and help ensure people leaving custody have the support they need to move forward.

If you're passionate about partnership working, improving services and making a meaningful difference to people's lives, we'd love to hear from you. Travel across London may be required.

About Us

We are The Forward Trust, the social enterprise with charitable status that empowers people to break the often interlinked cycles of crime and addiction to move forward with their lives. For more than 25 years we have been working with people to build positive and productive lives, whatever their past. We believe that anyone is capable of lasting change. Our services have supported thousands of people to make positive changes and build productive lives with a job, family, friends and a sense of community.

Please note that we may close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

Please note that remote roles may require occasional travel for site visits, training and meetings.

To Apply

company: Job Box Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Creative Marketing CoordinatorThe chance to make your mark on a brand that refuses to blend in.

Are you the kind of marketer who can spot a great idea before everyone else has seen it?

Someone who gets genuinely excited about creating a Reel that people actually want to watch - but is equally interested in what happened to sales afterwards?

We're looking for a Creative Marketing Coordinator who can bring together creativity, content and commercial thinking to help shape the next chapter of an ambitious, design-led brand.

This is not a role where your ideas disappear into a spreadsheet.

You'll have the freedom to come up with the ideas, make them happen, put them in front of the right audience - and see what they do.

What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of the day-to-day marketing activity, turning big ideas into campaigns that people notice and results that can be measured.

One day might involve dreaming up and filming a short-form video. The next could see you directing a content shoot, planning a product launch, tweaking paid campaigns or diving into the numbers to work out what's working - and what needs to change.

You'll be responsible for:
- Building and managing an exciting, joined-up marketing calendar across launches, campaigns, promotions, collaborations and events.
- Coming up with original campaign concepts, creative ideas and visual direction.
- Taking the lead on Instagram and TikTok - from strategy and content planning through to scripting, filming, editing, copywriting and community engagement.
- Creating scroll-stopping Reels, TikToks, Stories and other platform-native content.
- Planning and directing shoots, including concepts, moodboards, styling, shot lists and working with photographers, creators and influencers.
- Keeping your finger firmly on the pulse of social trends and knowing which ones are worth jumping on.
- Managing and optimising Google Ads, including budgets, targeting, creative testing and performance.
- Supporting paid social campaigns and constantly testing what makes audiences click, engage and buy.
- Working with the wider team on landing pages, email campaigns, promotions and other activity designed to turn attention into action.
- Tracking performance across social, paid media and digital channels - using the numbers to make smarter creative decisions.
- Building relationships with creators, stylists, designers, press and other exciting partners.
- Finding opportunities to create content and generate buzz around launches, events, projects and everything else worth talking about.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, creatively ambitious and commercially switched on.

You might currently be working in social media, content, digital marketing or a broader marketing role. What matters most is that you can demonstrate what you've created - and ideally, what it achieved.

You'll need:
- Proven hands-on marketing, social media or content experience.
- A portfolio that shows genuinely original ideas and strong creative execution.
- Excellent knowledge of Instagram and TikTok, including hooks, trends, storytelling and community building.
- Confidence filming and editing short-form video.
- Practical experience with Google Ads and Google Analytics 4.
- An understanding of Meta Ads and paid social.
- A seriously good visual eye and the ability to create content that feels distinctive rather than generic.
- Strong copywriting skills and the ability to adapt your voice across social, email, web and campaigns.
- A commercial mindset - you understand that likes are nice, but growth, traffic and revenue matter too.
- Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle multiple projects without losing your creative spark.
- The confidence to take an idea from "what if we ?" to "look what we've just done."

Experience across e-commerce, photography, styling, influencer marketing, email, B2 B or similar areas would be a bonus.

Why this role?

Because you'll actually get to do the marketing.

You'll have genuine ownership, creative freedom and the opportunity to see your ideas move from a scribble on a page to a finished campaign in the real world.

You'll work closely with decision-makers, have the freedom to experiment and play a meaningful part in shaping the future direction of the brand.

There's plenty to get stuck into, plenty of room to grow, and absolutely no expectation that you'll sit quietly in the corner waiting for someone to tell you what to post.

If you're creative enough to make people stop scrolling - and commercially minded enough to care what happens next - we'd love to hear from you.

title: GP Receptionist
description: A Receptionist role at Stanhope Mews West Surgery in South Kensington is a high-paced, patient-facing position within a large and "high-performing" GP practice (serving approximately 16,000 patients). Job Overview The Medical Receptionist is the first point of contact for our Practice. Your goal is to provide a professional, welcoming environment for patients while ensuring the efficient coordination of healthcare services. You will facilitate clear communication between patients, the clinical team, and external healthcare agencies. Front-of-House: Greet patients and visitors warmly, directing them to the appropriate clinician or service. Appointment Management: Maintain the practice scheduling system, processing requests for appointments, home visits, and telephone consultations. Communication: Manage incoming and outgoing mail, take accurate messages, and handle telephone inquiries efficiently. Prescription Support: Process repeat prescription requests according to practice guidelines, coordinating with the Patient Liaison Officer. Records: Maintain accurate filing systems (digital and physical) and ensure timely data entry into patient records. Clerical Support: Provide general assistance to clinical and management staff, including word processing, scanning, and photocopying. Supply Management: Monitor and reorder stationery and medical supplies to ensure the practice remains fully stocked. Security: Manage the opening and locking of premises and adhere strictly to security protocols. Environment: Keep reception, waiting areas, and notice boards tidy. Ensure consulting rooms are cleared and restocked daily. Facilities: Assist with staff refreshments and maintain cleanliness in the kitchen area. Forwarding forms to the appropriate GP or partner for completion. Monitoring outstanding requests and following up incomplete forms. Ensuring completed documents are scanned and stored in the patients record. Dispatching completed documentation promptly to patients or requesting organisations. Processing income generated from these services and chasing outstanding payments. Distributing income received to salaried doctors where appropriate. Collating partner income and submitting records to the Business Manager and Finance Administrator for payroll processing. Subject Access Requests (Medical Records) Ensure requests for copies of medical records are processed within 28 working days. Logging all requests with the date of receipt. Preparing copies of paper and electronic records. Completing the initial check for third-party information. Passing records to a GP to check for third-party information. Ensuring redacted pages are scanned and appropriately coded in the patient record. Arranging secure transfer of records via recorded delivery, collection or encrypted email. Cervical Screening Administration Provide administrative support for the Cervical Screening Programme in accordance with national protocols. Inputting smear screening data into patient records. Monitoring and chasing outstanding smear results. Sending recall letters to non-responders. Processing Prior Notification Lists via Open Exeter within deadlines. Managing the colposcopy failsafe system. Supporting quarterly cervical screening targets as part of QoF and Enhanced Services. Medical Records Management Process urgent medical record requests and complete the appropriate request forms. Email urgent requests to PCSE and file copies within patient records. Follow up with PCSE if records are delayed. Ensure newly received records are reviewed by a GP and passed for summarisation if required. Document Management Undertake daily scanning of completed medical reports, insurance forms and related correspondence. Ensure scanning is completed in line with the Docman protocol. Additional Duties Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance requirements. Maintain up-to-date contact records for affiliated organisations and services. Provide support to the management team when required. Assist with reception cover during staff shortages. Support practice activities such as the annual Flu Campaign and QOF targets. Undertake relevant training courses with agreement from the Practice Manager. Prepare refreshments for doctors coffee according to the rota. The Practice Manager will allocate duties, or the Business Manager in their absence. Duties may change to meet the operational needs of the practice. This job description is not exhaustive and may be amended by agreement between the Practice Manager and the post holder.

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit a full time/part-time receptionist to join our friendly GP practice team. Applicants should have GP receptionist experience and knowledge of SystmOne. GP receptionists will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. We are looking for a candidate who can be flexible within the role, to have the ability to adapt to the daily needs of the practice and to support annual leave cover and absences when required. Managing a high volume of phone calls from patients and health care professionals Greeting, checking-in and booking appointments for patients at the front desk Dealing with day-to-day administration tasks, including processing referrals, online patient requests, and other documents Dealing with repeat prescription requests Responding efficiently and with respect and empathy to patient enquiries both in person, by telephone and online Advise patients of relevant charges for non-NHS services, accept payment and issue receipts Remaining patient and calm in often stressful situations Scanning, filing and photocopying documents Clerical support to GPs and the wider healthcare team Understand and disseminate NHS wider policies to patients when requested Undertake any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the management team Support the practice team with patient wellbeing events such as patient coffee mornings/drinks This role is to recruit a medical receptionist. The successful candidate needs to be flexible within the role and have the ability to adapt to the daily needs of the practice and cover annual leave and absences when required. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. To work closely with the other reception staff to ensure the smooth running of reception and efficient delivery of services to the patients.

title: Ward Clerk
description: The Emergency & Integrated Medicine Care Service Unit (ICSU) is looking to recruit a Band 3 Ward Clerk to work within dedicated specialty areas. We are seeking a highly motivated and organised individual to join a busy team. This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive and self-motivated individual who enjoys working in a fast paced environment. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and an ability to work under pressure is essential to the role. The ideal candidate will have NHS experience and a flexible approach to work. They willtake responsibility, without close supervision, for providing administrative support to the Emergency and Integrated Medicine Acute Wards. The post holder will answer telephone calls and redirect as necessary, carrying out their duties in a polite and professional manner. This is a patient facing role and will require an individual who has a calm demeanour and an ability to work in a dynamic environment. The post will start as soon as possible. To liaise with a range of other health professionals and departments within the hospital ensuring the department interfaces efficiently with them. To respect patient and staff confidentiality. Attend and participate in regular team meetings for the ward and any others as required and to participate in discussions concerning ways to improve the provisions of service. Ensure compliance with all Trust policies regarding absence, annual, sick and other leave; sickness where possible must be reported to the Supervisor two hours before start of duty on the day of sickness. Responding to telephone queries in a professional and courteous manner, redirecting to the appropriate person and escalating any issues to the Charge Nurse. Maintaining the stock and supply of printed stationery to ensure constant availability for the nurses and doctors. Greeting patients and visitors and notifying patients' nurse that there are visitors To work closely with the discharge team in facilitating safe and efficient discharge processes. Ward Clerk Duties Maintain casenotes in line with policy, arranging for casenotes to be merged where required. Registering patients on Medway, transferring to other wards and discharging. Updating patients details on the electronic patient register (EPR) to a very high degree of accuracy. Maintaining patient transfer book and updating patient status whiteboard where required. Uploading Friends and Family Test patient feedback to the Meridian system. Locating the whereabouts of casenotes and collecting as required. Booking of interpreters, greeting upon arrival and referring to relevant staff. Other supporting activities: Maintain professional, friendly, customer focused relationships with patients on the ward Stocking the leaflet rack Liaise with the nurse in charge to establish priorities Booking of volunteer services To photocopy, collate and file reports, results and information sheets as requested. Order stock on an ad-hoc basis with the Ward Manager. Be responsible for reporting faults and maintenance problems within the ward and following up with Ward Manager/Nurse in charge. Ensure that all communications are dealt with confidentially and discreetly and that a sensitive approach is used. Training and Development To be appraised annually as part of the Trusts Individual Performance review and Personal

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Law Medical Group Practice, is seeking a reliable and organised Receptionist to join our team. The practice is committed to delivering high-quality primary care services to our local community and supporting patients through efficient administrative and reception support systems. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the multidisciplinary team by undertaking a range of reception and patient-facing duties. This includes managing appointments through EMIS, handling patient queries, processing incoming correspondence, and ensuring that important information is accurately directed to the relevant clinicians. The role will involve front-of-house responsibilities, including welcoming and directing patients, responding to queries, and assisting patients both in person and over the phone in a professional and efficient manner. Working Pattern: This role can be offered on either a full-time or part-time basis, as per the below schedules: Full-time: Monday - Friday: 11:00am - 7:00pm or Part-time: Monday, Wednesday & Friday: 1:30pm - 7:00pm Tuesday: 1:00pm - 7:00pm Thursday: 1:30pm - 6:30pm Please note: The above working days and hours are strictly non-negotiable. Eligibility: This position is open only to UK citizens with a minimum of 5 years working experience in the UK. The role involves providing comprehensive reception support to the multidisciplinary team within the practice. Key responsibilities include managing patient interactions, handling incoming correspondence, and ensuring accurate distribution of information to clinicians. The position includes front-desk duties such as greeting and directing patients, managing the appointment system using EMIS , booking appointments, responding to patient enquiries, and supporting the smooth and efficient day-to-day operation of the practice. The following are the core responsibilities of the Medical Receptionist . There may occasionally be a requirement to carry out other duties depending on workload, operational needs, and staffing levels. Primary Responsibilities Receive and process correspondence from hospitals, external healthcare providers, and other agencies. Scan and upload documents onto the EMIS clinical system, ensuring accurate patient record management. Review and appropriately allocate documents within EMIS , forwarding them to the relevant clinician for review and action. Initiate and respond to requests from patients, practice staff, and external healthcare agencies in a professional and timely manner. Photocopy and prepare documentation as required by clinicians and practice staff. Provide cover for colleagues during periods of absence to ensure continuity of service. Accurately input patient information and updates into EMIS where required. Manage and resolve patient queries efficiently, escalating issues where appropriate. Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient reception environment at all times. Support the clinical team with day-to-day operational tasks as required. Complete tasks relating to patient results, correspondence, and clinical letters where appropriate. Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in managing changing workloads and priorities to ensure the smooth operation of the practice. Use EMIS and other digital systems effectively for patient record management, appointment scheduling, and internal communication. Secondary Responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the Medical Receptionist may also be required to: Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system using EMIS . Process appointment requests received in person, by telephone, and via online systems. Answer incoming telephone calls and direct them appropriately or deal with enquiries where possible. Signpost patients to the appropriate healthcare professional or NHS service. Support practice audits and administrative reviews as directed by management. Process incoming electronic communications and documents where required. Scan and attach patient-related documentation accurately to patient records within EMIS . Carry out opening and closing procedures in accordance with the practice rota and operational requirements.

title: Practice Administrator
description: We are recruiting for part time administrator at our practice based in Clapham, SW4. This is for maternity leave cover with a minimum of 9 months contract which may be extended up to 1 year. The successful applicant must be able to start mid October and must have experience of managing SARS/Insurance reports/DWP forms etc. 12 hours per week- 4 hours per day to be worked between 9am-5pm. Working days will be Monday/Wednesday & Friday Hourly Rate: £14.80 per hour. The successful applicant will be an integral part of our Primary Care team, supporting the delivery of high standard patient care. As the first point of contact for our patients and and outside agencies, they will have excellent customer service skills, experience and/or an excellent understanding of managing medical reports, SARS and letter requests from outside agencies- Solicitors/DWP/Insurance companies- & our patients and the associated processes. Managing all aspects of Medical Reports/SARS/Private letters and forms Managing the IGPR system and software Liaising with patients and practice staff in relation to the above Ordering supplies for the practice- medical, stationery, toners. Providing support to our administrator and reception team as required. The successful candidate will be required to be flexible, providing cover for annual leave and sick leave. PREVIOUS APPLICANTS NEED NOT APPLY The key responsibilities for this role are: Assisting our Registration Clerk with the processing of online registrations RESPONSIBLE TO: Assistant Practice Manager The primary role of the practice administrator is to manage requests made to the practice for Medical Reports and SARS requests, in addition to these duties, the post holder will be required to provide urgent cover for our registration administrator as directed by the Assistant Practice Manager. The post holder must have an excellent understanding of Access to Medical Records and Data protection. In addition, excellent IT skills are required and experience of using IGPR software is desired but not essential. It is important that all members of staff are prepared to take on additional duties or relinquish existing duties to maintain efficient running of the practice and changes in how services are provided. The Partners reserve the right to redistribute duties and functions among members of staff from time to time and requests for such changes shall not be reasonably refused. Duties and Responsibilities Managing and processing requests for Medical Reports and SARS requests Ensure upon receipt of requests for SARS and Medical Reports, all details are logged onto spreadsheet and reviewing and updating accordingly. Responsible for processing requests within specific time frames & following correct process. Manage requests for completion of private forms and requests for letters. Including discussing fees with both patients and clinicians. Manage requests from outside agencies for reports such as Child Protection/ Police Manage and maintain the IGPR data and software. Be the liaison between insurance companies and patients in relation viewing reports prior to sending. Responsible for redacting record entries relating to SARS and liaise with clinicians as required. First point of contact for patients in relation to requests and queries relating to private letters/completion forms Managing and responding to tasks sent by reception & clinical team in a timely manner. Ordering supplies: Responsible for the ordering of stationery, medical and IT supplies, ensuring stock is managed effectively and storeroom well maintained. . Other Duties : Provide cover in the absence of the registration administrator, ensuring all online registrations via Health Tec1 software, are processed, as required and instructed by the Assistant Practice Manager. Education Attend practice meetings. Attend suitable educational courses outside the practice. Attend training sessions within the practice. Complete mandatory Practice Index modules as required Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate This job description will be reviewed at your regular staff appraisal. PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential Desirable Excellent IT skills including Excel/ Word Working knowledge of EMIS Excellent Knowledge of Data Protection and Access to Medical Records Working knowledge of Docman/Accurx Aptitude to learn new software & processes Working knowledge of IGPR software Excellent time management & organisational skills Previous experience of working within the NHS Excellent customer service skills Knowledge of NHS registration processes Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team. Excellent communication skills both written and verbal It is the policy of Hetherington Group Practice that no job applicant or employee shall receive less favourable treatment than another on the grounds of sex, marital status, age, disability, race, religion, creed, colour, national origin or sexual orientation. This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. You must therefore disclose all spent and unspent convictions, cautions, reprimands and final warnings. If you are offered the post we will need to obtain a satisfactory DBS disclosure for you.
